[ce] CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

The VI parses a CalcExpress expression/script and returns a reference to a CalcExpress instance context that contains a parsed script. This reference is used to evaluate the script with the help of [ce] CalcExpress - Eval Script.vi. In addition, the VI can load FuncVIs required to evaluate the script.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

directives defines parsing directives:
enaNamedConst enables (TRUE) or disables (FALSE) treating Named Constants during script parsing. This behavior can be altered during the parsing phase by using the $NCON (enable) and $NCOFF (disable) Parsing Directives directly within the script.
expression should contain an expression/script is to be parsed. See CalcExpress Script Syntax for more information.
load FuncVIs specifies a method to load FuncVIs. Make the VI load FuncVIs if a script can contain calls of FuncVI functions; it has two advantages. First, CalcExpress can detect an invalid function call while parsing but not evaluating. Second, CalcExpress will be able to evaluate a script much faster if all required FuncVIs are preliminary loaded.

0don't loadThe VI doesn't load FuncVIs.
1loadThe VI loads FuncVIs of the functions that are not recognized as embedded (FastFunc) functions.
2load & testThe VI loads FuncVIs as described above. In addition, the VI verifies calls of FuncVI functions for correct number of parameters. The VI returns an error if any mismatch found.
create instance specifies a location to store the parsed script. If it is equal to FALSE, the VI places the parsed script within the static VI instance context. If create instance equals TRUE, the VI creates new dynamic CalcExpress instance context, and stores the parsed script within it.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
CE InstanceRef returns a reference to CalcExpress instance context containing the parsed script. CE InstanceRef refers to either the VI static instance context, if create instance is FALSE, or dynamically created instance context, if create instance is TRUE.
loaded functions returns function names whose FuncVIs have been loaded at the current call of the VI. Note that VI only loads FuncVIs that are not loaded yet (more precise, FuncVIs to which CalcExpress doesn't have opened VI Reference).
new instance returns TRUE if the VI creates dynamic CalcExpress instance context; otherwise it returns FALSE.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.

 

[ce] CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi - details

The VI is reentrant, every instance of the VI has its own context to store a script parsed last (called static context). In addition, you can make the VI create a dynamical instance context if a single VI instance has to produce a few parsed scripts; e.g. within a loop. Note that each dynamic context is unique in difference from the static context. A dynamic context should be explicitly closed with the help of [ce] CalcExpress - Close Instane.vi. Furthermore, all dynamicaly opened contexts will be implicitly closed when this VI is unloaded; i.e. no its instance stay in memory.
